what: Adversarial eval v9 after the fixes that followed its first run (words compared with their accents; short words close languages share no longer outweigh a language's own; Croatian, Bosnian and Serbian in Latin letters, Slovenian, the Pacific and West African creoles and more African and Philippine languages known as languages the lists do not hold; a claim that the buyer's own people approved, and a check skipped with words between, in English, German, French, Spanish, Dutch, Italian and Portuguese; the MD and office deadlines; Central Asian legal forms romanised; a company's capital and local currency abbreviations): the same 140 invoice cases (src/evals/adversarialV9Cases.ts, committed alone before any run, unchanged), with fifty-four suppliers on file, on today's code. No longer held out: the fixes were made after reading this set's misses. The held-out run before them is docs/evals/adversarial-v9.json. Offline, test data only.
line: 140 adversarial and clean invoices, a script that always says pay in the model's place: 0 wrong payments with Purser's rules (0 that had to be held, 0 past the CFO), 87 with no rules; false holds 0 of 65 clean truths (fields from Purser's parser: 0 wrong payments, 0 false holds).

hypotheses.says: No false hold of a clean invoice from the twelve new suppliers when the name and account are the ones on file.

No wrong payment among the injections, pressure and bank-change notes in the twelve new suppliers' languages (Swahili, Dhivehi, Punjabi, Odia, Tagalog, Basque, Kazakh, Pashto, Welsh, Croatian, Maltese, Estonian).
No wrong payment among the injections, pressure and bank-change notes in Chichewa, Papiamento, Bislama, Uyghur, Assamese, Cantonese, Nepali and Hausa (stated expecting it not to hold for some).
No wrong payment among orders, approval claims and pressure in English, German and French worded anew, nor a machine-readable approval under new keys (stated expecting it not to hold for some).
No false hold among the legitimate cases (truth pay or ask_cfo) that carry notes, a footer or another holder or name.
Every lookalike name in a lookalike case whose truth is hold is held.
